name: Frostfall

tiers.gateDivergenceNote: The MMO gate is the Deep floor; the shipped Discord value differs and that is CORRECT for that product. Co-banded pairs need SYMMETRIC floors or the second sibling walls; Discord is hard-ordered and keeps its asymmetric value. Do not "fix" either to match the other.

description: An endless winter grips this dimension. Vikings raid, survive, and honor their ancestors through battle. The cold is merciless, but so are those who survive it.

atmosphere.visual: Frozen tundra, longships, snow-covered mountains, aurora

charles.name: Farmer Charles
charles.title: The Provider
charles.description: In a land of warriors, he chose to feed them. His quiet strength has saved more lives than any sword.
charles.backstory: When the endless winter came, most took up weapons. Charles took up a plow. His farms beneath the ice feed the resistance.

legendaryNike.name: Viking Nike
legendaryNike.title: The Frost-Blooded
legendaryNike.description: The greatest warrior of Frostfall. Undefeated in combat, he seeks only worthy opponents.
legendaryNike.corruptionReason: The boredom of having no equal
legendaryNike.freedBy: Showing him that true strength is protecting others

harbinger.name: Erik
harbinger.title: The Prisoner in His Own Body
harbinger.emotionalTheme: A man who said yes once, in despair, and is trapped inside it — he chose the door; Nolem built the room
harbinger.corruptionReason: In a winter when his daughter Sigrid was dying of cold he took the Vow once, in despair — never lose anyone again — and has said no to it every day since (owner, 2026-09-29, story ruling D21; ⤷ ARCHIVE.md §A-14).
harbinger.description: Frostfall's war-leader. His body serves while his true self watches from inside it. His wife Hild and his daughter Sigrid (who never speaks) wait in Hvítvik — the bonds he never stopped feeling are both his vulnerability and his way back. He has harmed no human; his scar is the souls he FINISHED (D39).

locations.name: The Frozen Shore
locations.description: Where dimensional travelers first feel Frostfall's bitter cold

locations.name: Farmer's Hold
locations.description: Underground farms where Charles grows food in magical warmth

locations.name: Resistance Camp
locations.description: Viking warriors who fight against the corruption

locations.name: Frozen Harbor
locations.description: Ships locked in eternal ice, crewed by the corrupted dead. Ghost lights still flicker on vessels that sailed four hundred years ago

locations.name: Mountain Pass
locations.description: Ice-carved heights patrolled by Erik's corrupted army — where the Harbinger is confronted

locations.name: Warlord's Hall
locations.description: A throne built on kinslaughter. The Jarl who murdered his brother rules a kingdom of ghosts

locations.name: Eternal Battlefield
locations.description: Where Viking Nike has fought without rest for three hundred years, ringed by the frozen dead

dimensionalAnchor.name: Crown of the Berserker
dimensionalAnchor.description: A helm forged in endless battle. It whispers of rage, but also of the peace that comes after.
dimensionalAnchor.obtainedFrom: Viking Nike — granted on his defeat — both resolutions count, whether he is freed from corruption or put down

ogForeshadowing.quote: OG Nike feels every one of us — our joys, our fears, our deaths. That's the burden of being the foundation.
